meta.title: Seasons Around the World — Set 4
meta.subject: English Reading
meta.description: Fill-in and sentence practice quiz for 'Seasons Around the World'.

questions.question: Some animals _______ during the winter months.
questions.explanation: To hibernate means to sleep through the winter, which is what some animals do.

questions.question: In winter, the air gets cold and it snows in many places.
questions.explanation: True. Cold air and snow are key features of winter in many parts of the world.

questions.question: Near the North Pole, the sun never shines in winter. It is _______ all day.
questions.explanation: When the sun never shines, it is dark, just like night all day long.

questions.question: Sunlight helps plants grow in the summer.
questions.explanation: True. Plants need sunlight to make food and grow, and summer has long sunny days.

questions.question: Baby animals are born in _______ in many places.
questions.explanation: Spring is the season of new life, when many baby animals are born.

questions.question: In fall, animals get ready for winter and some _______ food.
questions.hint: To collect and save for later.
questions.explanation: Animals store food in fall so they have something to eat when it is cold.

questions.question: In fall, the leaves on some trees change colors and _______.
questions.explanation: In fall, leaves turn yellow, orange, or red and then drop to the ground.

questions.question: Sort these animal actions based on whether they do them in Winter or Autumn:
questions.explanation: Hibernating and the dark North Pole are winter facts. Leaves falling, migrating, and eating are autumn actions.

questions.question: The word 'equator' refers to the top part of the Earth near the North Pole.
questions.explanation: False. The equator is the imaginary middle line around the Earth, far from the poles.

questions.question: Arrange the words to describe spring rain:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'It can rain a lot in spring.' Spring is often a wet season.

questions.question: In spring, what helps plants grow?
questions.explanation: Rain provides water, and warmer weather provides warmth, which help plants grow.

questions.question: In summer, the days are _______ than they are during winter.
questions.explanation: Summer has the longest days of the year, with lots of sunlight.

questions.question: Arrange the words to describe Antarctica:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth.' It stays frozen all year.

questions.question: Near the equator, spring is different because it snows a lot.
questions.explanation: False. Seasons don't change much near the equator, and it never snows there.

questions.question: In fall, many birds and animals move to warmer places where they can _______.
questions.explanation: Animals move to warmer places in fall specifically to find food, since food becomes scarce in the cold winter.
